All of the voice beeps for the tech priest characters, minus the Heretek DLC
Couldn't find this anywhere, so i made it myself

heretek dlc voices: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n-cZkW30IHI
controllable tech priests and troops: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dqr8Bx1V5n0
